episode_summary: In this episode, Bella Chaffey Lakic shares her journey from a young REALTOR with no sphere to a successful agent leveraging YouTube for lead generation. She discusses the importance of creating evergreen content, staying connected with clients, and the value of community involvement. Bella provides actionable insights on using video marketing effectively, even without a large budget or professional equipment.
